en.tagline: One toolkit for Bilibili hot lists, downloads, subtitles and publishing
en.summary: bilibili-all-in-one is a Python toolkit for Bilibili. It covers hot and ranking lists, video downloads, stats tracking, subtitles, playback info and danmaku, and video publishing. You call it from the command line or from Python code, and each action returns a JSON result.
problem: Working with Bilibili from scripts or agents usually means writing separate code for each task. Hot lists, downloads, subtitles and uploads each need their own API handling and their own input format.

With this skill, all six modules share one entry point, `main.py`, and one response format. Most read-only tasks work without any login. Only high-quality downloads, some playback URLs and publishing need Bilibili session cookies.
fit: Pulling hot, trending, weekly must-watch or category ranking lists from a script
Downloading videos as MP4 or extracting audio as MP3, one at a time or in batches
Listing and downloading subtitles, converting or merging subtitle files, and using speech recognition when no CC subtitles exist
Uploading, scheduling, drafting or editing videos on your own account
unfit: Users who do not want to give session cookies for publishing or 1080p+ and 4K downloads
steps: Install the dependencies with `pip install -r requirements.txt`.
Choose a module such as `hot_monitor`, `downloader`, `watcher`, `subtitle`, `player` or `publisher`, and choose one of its actions.
Run it from the command line with `python main.py <module> <action> '<params_json>'`, or call `app.execute(module, action, ...)` from Python.
Public actions run without credentials. High-quality downloads, high-quality playback URLs and publishing need `BILIBILI_SESSDATA` and `BILIBILI_BILI_JCT`.
Credentials stay in memory by default. Saving them to `.credentials.json` happens only when persistence is turned on.
Each action returns a JSON object. A `success` field tells you whether it worked, and failed calls include a `message`.

zh.tagline: 一套工具处理B站热门榜单、下载、字幕与投稿
zh.summary: bilibili-all-in-one 是一个面向 B 站的 Python 工具包。它覆盖热门与排行榜、视频下载、数据统计、字幕、播放信息与弹幕，以及视频投稿。可以通过命令行或 Python 代码调用，每个操作返回 JSON 结果。
problem: 在脚本或智能体中处理 B 站任务，通常要为每项工作分别写代码。热门榜单、下载、字幕和投稿各自需要单独处理接口和输入格式。
使用本 Skill 后，六个模块共用一个入口 `main.py` 和同一种返回格式。大多数只读操作无需登录。只有高画质下载、部分播放地址和投稿需要提供 B 站会话 Cookie。
fit: 在脚本中获取热门、热搜、必看榜或分区排行榜
下载视频为 MP4 或提取音频为 MP3，可单个或批量处理
列出并下载字幕，转换或合并字幕文件；无 CC 字幕时使用语音识别
在自己的账号下上传、定时发布、保存草稿或编辑视频
unfit: 不愿提供会话 Cookie 用于投稿或下载 1080p+、4K 画质的用户
需要处理 B 站以外平台的场景
steps: 运行 `pip install -r requirements.txt` 安装依赖。
选择模块，如 `hot_monitor`、`downloader`、`watcher`、`subtitle`、`player` 或 `publisher`，再选择其中的一个操作。
用命令行 `python main.py <模块> <操作> '<参数JSON>'` 运行，或在 Python 中调用 `app.execute(模块, 操作, ...)`。
公开操作无需凭证。高画质下载、高画质播放地址和投稿需要 `BILIBILI_SESSDATA` 和 `BILIBILI_BILI_JCT`。
凭证默认只保存在内存中。只有开启持久化后，才会写入 `.credentials.json`。
每个操作返回一个 JSON 对象。`success` 字段表示是否成功，失败时包含 `message`。
